p = Path('src/core/holeSceneSensors.test.ts')

    "    expect(hazardSurfaceTop(hole, pitDescriptor)).toBeCloseTo(-0.5);"

assert old in s, 'anchor not found'
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
